implemented_uncommitted: scene_coordinates::ScenePlanPoint has const checked admission with identical finite-component contract; file-level items reordered without new tests.

scene/queries.rs owns checked height/coarse-height/normal queries, optional ordered SceneElevationRange and canonical TerrainSupportError/Result required-query APIs. Sampled triangle arithmetic and original SurfaceHit admission are retained.

property_support and SceneGarden forwarding no longer erase and re-admit support leaves. SceneGround and urban application queries retain ScenePlanPoint to native grid/polygon calculations; building bounds reuse an already checked placement centre.

Source refinement/relief responsibility extracted from the large scene_input.rs root. Refinement/rewrite callbacks retain ScenePlanPoint and SupportElevation; completed equations admit their results. Source rewrite failure is propagated through the existing typed DetailTerrain rejection.

Road probing/formula moved to a focused child; its -1 initial score is explicit Option with unchanged strict-better tie selection. Existing exact-bit road golden moved and registered, without new cases.

Furniture placement retains checked centre/corner points through activity/collar/support queries; the playable branch keeps its checked support, and only completed native vista interpolation is admitted.

Canonical edge-extended landform support owner accepts ScenePlanPoint and returns TerrainRecipeResult<SupportElevation>; both old panic-on-missing-height helpers are removed. TerrainRecipeError preserves TerrainSupportError as its source and no longer derives Eq for its float-backed point payload.

Erosional density fields and general marching callbacks propagate TerrainRecipeResult without erasing support measurements before completed native equations. Fault-scarp preparation propagates parallel query failures before erosion and retains checked elevation bounds until the actual lattice equations. Completed nonfinite candidate heights are rejected before min/max can hide them.

Native vista stitching retains checked playable support until the final lerp; unsupported playable support preserves the existing real vista sample. Existing Core/grounding/garden/furniture/generator fixtures are adapted to checked ports with the same names, cases and assertion counts.
Scarp grid minimum is now ScenePlanPoint from its producer through SimulatedScarpSurface, erosion and ScarpResistanceGrid; projection occurs only inside native grid/stencil arithmetic.

FootClearanceFloor now keeps Minimum(SignedLength) distinct from Terrain{surface:SupportElevation,clearance:SignedLength}; implicit From<SignedLength> is removed. Completed direct floors are checked before target.max, including ordinary_terrain_target.

Foot/flight callbacks carry ScenePlanPoint and Option<FootClearanceFloor>. Toe and transition producers retain SupportElevation to actual arithmetic; the complete sole-first/toe-second maximum is preserved before checked floor admission. Nonfinite completed native query points use the existing AnimationValueError::Overflow(WorldPosition).

Ordinary locomotion consumes SupportElevation directly. Both application slope-alignment forwarders now take Dir3 and project only into the unchanged complete rotation kernel; the two original slope fixture functions remain byte-identical; the file also contains other adapted fixtures and is not wholly unchanged.

Run terrain callbacks, terminal settle, raised guard and propagated support predicates retain ScenePlanPoint and SupportElevation; complete native run reach/motion operations moved to terrain_contacts/run_reach.rs.
Coordinator floors remain FootClearanceFloor to native target correction; complete run/settle target responsibilities extracted instead of growing the large coordinator.
Pose-buffer contacts and ragdoll multi-terrain maximum retain checked support until native height/capsule arithmetic. SupportElevation::max owns the exact existing finite f32::max operation.
AnimationDiagnosticRecord retains Option<SupportElevation> through transparent Serde; derived clearances project at subtraction.

TerrainContactHeightmap couples Image and SceneElevationRange. Missing range, required physical texel or invalid coordinate is rejected; finite encoding-range and native image-width admission are explicit.

Tree residency admits the complete new raster before retaining or changing the active cache; image, scene digest and typed range are retained together, without a contact-heightmap expect. Bark material bounds project only into the GPU Vec4.

Weather clears the previous particles first, admits the whole image before any new particle layer, and shares checked bounds through falling, impact and sheet materials and the matching occlusion update. The tree signature is assigned only after the image update.
Woody weather occlusion moved to a focused module with its existing footprint test. Empty raster cells use Option rather than NEG_INFINITY; native raster math and alpha meaning are retained.

ActiveVistaSurface and StrategicBackdrop application queries retain checked points/elevations around complete native interpolation/stitch kernels. TerrainDetailPatch keeps its checked snapped centre; lattice points are admitted once and reused for fine/coarse samples.

Existing fixtures adapted with their original inputs, cases and assertions. The client test-only road estimator also uses an explicit uninitialized Option score with the same strict-better first-tie policy.

Vista scenery and environment queries take ScenePlanPoint; tree roots retain SupportElevation through complete native interpolation and actual Transform construction. Owned support uses its existing SurfaceHit directly.

ShrubPlacement retains one checked point from grid/jitter birth through understory sampling and instance production. Litter keeps its checked grid origin and admits the completed jittered point before cover/support queries. Pebble support retains checked point/elevation/normal until native scree/rotation/Transform math.

TuftPlacement coverage, height and community APIs retain ScenePlanPoint; height returns SupportElevation. The common lattice admits each completed tuft footprint once before all three queries. CoverageMask and GrassCommunityField project only inside their actual UV/grid/Voronoi calculations.

PlantSite.root, PlantCaptureAnchor.root, capture-state plant_focus, botanical camera input and LOD observation input use Position<Scene>. Native seed priority/x/z bit ordering is unchanged. Projection occurs at Transform construction or actual camera/distance/diagnostic arithmetic.

Strategic preparation uses owned errors plus shared retained error handles. Native PreparedStrategicScene generation reuses the existing generation PreparationResult, matching worker activation. SceneInput, Generation, Geometry, Backdrop, canonical TerrainSupportError and opaque BevyError payloads survive until the serialized status boundary. No new String catch-all or message branching.

Street front, Venue anchors/approaches and retained strategic actor anchors use Position<Scene>. Required backdrop observations replace zero/previous-anchor support fallbacks. Building relocation and selection use named records; existing architectural staging remains outside P06.

Server terrain selection waits before taking connected rows; multiple authoritative terrains reject. Missing loading recipients retain the existing warning/omission before geometry. Enemy fixture selection and every applicable placement are admitted before any row is projected. Positions remain Position<Scene> to actual Transform insertion.

The complete obstacle batch is admitted before any obstacle command. Native serialized grid ordinal arithmetic, collision offsets and seed yaw are preserved. on_server_started propagates SceneSpawnError through its existing Bevy Result. No generated bindings or schema changed.

Animation capture setup/reset/root motion/ragdoll now reject missing physical support and invalid complete positions through CaptureAdmission. Authored-plane observations remain distinct. A closed admission run condition precedes the drive system Single terrain parameter. Root motion is extracted.
TerrainSummary retains checked elevation bounds through Serde, with metres projected only in final camera arithmetic.
Dispatcher geology and mapped fault surfaces retain checked scene points through finite differences and actual Proj4 projection. MappedLandformProfile names the kind/lithology payload.

InspectionSource owns diagnostic playable/vista support sampling. Thresholds, terrace callbacks, gate profiles, comparisons and perimeter quantities retain checked points/elevations. Source observations have a focused owner and typed missing-opening rejection.

Extrema use canonical GeographicHeightControl with strict comparisons. The optional displacement maximum uses SurfaceDifferenceControl: absence no longer claims zero at origin, and a real first zero keeps its actual point. Native clipping/interpolation/integration are preserved.

Viewer boundary captures retain all ten unchanged authored points and reject missing terrain/support by failure.txt plus AppExit::error. Optional debris remains optional. Required camera/catalog/understory support no longer defaults to zero or panics at the query.

Viewer obstacle admission completes the batch before physics/overlay commands and retains Position<Scene> to Transform. Projection/native visual setup and catalogue staging/framing are extracted from large roots.
Two existing production asserts become typed failures; no test assertions/cases/helpers are added or removed.

Oak sites retain checked footprint/elevation/root through ranking and focus. Neighbour absence uses the real observed centre as the existing slope estimator did. Species/variant/obstacle identity APIs take ScenePlanPoint, ending at actual community or bit-framing kernels.
Art-demo errors preserve structured JSON/SceneInput/collider/weapon/asset-load causes through exhibit/cache state using Arc. Only final DemoStatus text formats them.

Retained tree-variant restoration now belongs to residency; a named TerrainBarkBinding shares the admitted contact/terrain/material inputs for restored and newly generated bark. The presenter raw source excerpt shrinks from 148 to 142 lines; the official quality gate has not run.
